title: Buying the Bogart-Bacall house in 1946
summary: Herman bought the Hollywood house from Humphrey Bogart and Lauren Bacall in 1946, furnished, and has lived there 32 years.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You -- I wanted to just zip back to a-- the house was owned by Humphrey Bogart?

And Lauren Bacall. They bought it when they were married, when they became married, and lived there for the first year of their married life. And then she decided they needed a bigger house. They were going to be entertaining. And they moved and -- we bought it, and they moved somewhere else
So you bought it -- what, in 40 --
Yeah. And it was just nearing the end of the war, and certain things were still not available so we bought the house completely furnished with everything that was in it.
Which made it rather unique. And we found a lot of -- we still have things that have monograms on them, B&B.
Oh, is that what it meant?
Yeah. There's a music cabinet and a couple of things, a record cabinet.
So you found that suitable all these years, obviously.
It's 32 years that we've lived in the house. And we've had much enjoyment of the house, and it's the only home I've really ever known, other than Milwaukee.
